payload.prompt: Which statements correctly describe generative AI?

options.text: It is a subset of artificial intelligence.
options.rationale: Generative AI is part of artificial intelligence. It is not the same as the whole field.

options.text: It focuses on creating new content.
options.rationale: Creating new content is the defining focus of generative AI. This includes outputs such as text, code, images, or videos.

options.text: It has quickly changed how people work.
options.rationale: Generative AI has changed work practices in a short time. It has also expanded what is possible with technology.

options.text: It is only a reusable agent package.
options.error_type: confuses generative AI with agents
options.rationale: An agent is a packaged, reusable component built on a model, instructions, and optional tools. Generative AI is the broader content-creating category.
options.better_fit: This fits agents, which package a model, instructions, and optional actions for repeated use.

feedback.intrinsic: A learner may think every content-creating model must be packaged as an agent before it can be useful.
feedback.instructional: Keep the levels separate. Generative AI creates new content; agents package model behavior for reusable tasks.

payload.feedback_for_correct: Correct. Generative AI is a subset of artificial intelligence that creates new content and has changed workplace tasks.

options.rationale: Code generation from natural language prompts is a common workplace use. GitHub Copilot can generate snippets and suggest functions.

payload.prompt: A project lead wants a platform that supports responsible enterprise AI work for copilots, agents, and AI-powered applications. Which Foundry capabilities match that need?

options.text: A rich model catalog
options.rationale: Foundry includes a rich model catalog for discovering and comparing models. This supports teams building copilots, agents, and powered applications.

options.text: Flexible deployment options
options.rationale: Foundry includes flexible deployment options. These help teams tailor performance, cost, and governance.

options.text: Built-in governance capabilities
options.rationale: Built-in governance capabilities support responsible enterprise work. They help teams build with enterprise confidence.

options.text: Only handwritten code with no platform support
